articles.title: Memory Makers Prioritize Server Applications, Driving Across-the-Board Price Increases in 1Q26, Says TrendForce
articles.mainIdea: Memory Makers Prioritize Server Applications, Driving Across-the-Board Price Increases in 1Q26, Says TrendForce
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Memory Makers Prioritize Server Applications, Driving Across-the-Board Price Increases in 1Q26, Says TrendForce. TrendForce's latest investigations indicate that DRAM suppliers in 1Q26 will continue to reallocate advanced process nodes and new capacity toward server and HBM products to support rising AI server demand. This shift has significantly limited supply in other markets, causing conventional DRAM contract prices to increase by about 55–60% QoQ. articles.title: Defense Stocks Boosted by U.S. Intervention in Venezuela as Geopolitical Risk Rises
articles.mainIdea: Defense Stocks Boosted by U.S. Intervention in Venezuela as Geopolitical Risk Rises
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Defense Stocks Boosted by U.S. Intervention in Venezuela as Geopolitical Risk Rises. European defense companies jumped in early European trading after the U.S. ousted Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro, while U.S. peers are expected to also trade higher when the market opens.
